name: Admin Design Reference

visualDirection.summary: Modern operational admin UI with quiet surfaces, tomato-red primary accents, mostly outlined buttons, dense but readable information, and Tailwind UI style ergonomics.

fontFamily.name: Satoshi
fontFamily.rationale: Modern non-serif family with a warmer geometric tone close to Ubuntu, but less dated and less Bootstrap-like.

rules: Use 0 letter spacing except small uppercase table headers and metadata labels.
Prefer sentence case for labels and actions.

usageRules: Use tomato red as the primary accent, not as a full-page wash.
Use neutral backgrounds for admin pages.
Prefer small status accents over large colorful panels.
Do not use Bootstrap-like blue as the primary brand color.
Avoid purple, purple-blue gradients, and one-hue dashboards.

layout.mainContent: mx-auto w-full max-w-[1440px] px-4 py-5 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layout.toolbar: flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-neutral-200 pb-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between

surfaces.inputSurface: rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-white text-neutral-950 shadow-none

buttons.philosophy: Buttons are mostly outlined. Solid buttons are reserved for the single most important action in a view.
buttons.base: inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: Prefer outlined buttons for list actions, filters, table row actions, and secondary workflows.
Use one solid primary button per page or modal when a clear primary action exists.
Use icons for compact tool actions such as edit, delete, refresh, search, export, and settings.
Avoid Bootstrap-like large pill buttons, heavy shadows, and default blue primary actions.

forms.label: mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-neutral-800
forms.input: h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-white px-3 text-sm text-neutral-950 placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:border-[var(--admin-primary)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:ring-[var(--admin-primary-border)]
forms.textarea: min-h-24 w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-neutral-950 placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:border-[var(--admin-primary)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:ring-[var(--admin-primary-border)]
forms.select: h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-300 bg-white px-3 text-sm text-neutral-950 focus:border-[var(--admin-primary)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:ring-[var(--admin-primary-border)]

navigation.sidebarItem: flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 text-sm font-medium text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100

tables.headerCell: px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-500

badges.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-md border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

cards.usage: Use cards for repeated records, compact KPI panels, and modal-like contained tasks. Do not nest cards.
cards.interactive: rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 bg-white p-4 transition-colors hover:border-neutral-300 hover:bg-neutral-50

modals.panel: w-full max-w-lg rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 bg-white shadow-xl
modals.footer: flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-neutral-100 px-5 py-4

structure: top utility bar with search and quick actions
page header with title and actions
rules: Prioritize tables and lists over large decorative cards.
Keep KPI cards compact but visually expressive with icons and deltas.
Use full-width page bands or plain sections instead of floating page sections.
Use sticky table headers and predictable row actions when tables grow.

structure: drawer or modal for create and edit
crudPage.primaryAction: Use one solid tomato button for create when needed; keep every other action outlined or ghost.

adminTopBar.base: flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(17,17,15,0.04)]
adminTopBar.search: h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-200 bg-neutral-50 px-4 text-sm text-neutral-900 placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:border-[var(--admin-primary)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--admin-primary-border)]
adminTopBar.actionButton: inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-neutral-200 bg-white px-3 text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-50

adminKpiCard.base: rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(17,17,15,0.04)]
adminKpiCard.iconWrap: flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-[var(--admin-primary-border)] bg-[var(--admin-primary-subtle)] text-[var(--admin-primary-hover)]
adminKpiCard.label: text-sm text-neutral-500

bootstrap: Do not use Bootstrap-like blue primary buttons.
Do not use rounded-pill button groups.
Do not use thick bordered cards with generic blue headers.
Do not use alert blocks that resemble Bootstrap alerts.
Do not use default-looking btn-primary, btn-secondary, form-control visual patterns.
visualNoise: Do not add gradient orbs, bokeh backgrounds, decorative blobs, or generic AI SaaS illustrations.
Do not use large shadows for ordinary admin panels.
Do not overuse rounded-xl and rounded-2xl in admin surfaces.
Do not make dashboards dominated by one hue.
Do not use marketing hero sections inside authenticated admin routes.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone for status.
Do not use text below 12px for interactive controls.
Do not create icon-only buttons without accessible labels or tooltips.

implementationRules: Use Tailwind utility classes and Nuxt UI conventions where applicable.
Use object syntax for conditional Vue classes.
Use semantic color names for variants: primary, neutral, success, warning, info, danger, error.
Use Iconify icons for all icons.
Keep admin cards at rounded-lg or less.
Default button variant should be outlined in admin views.
Prefer compact density with clear spacing over large marketing layouts.
Every new admin UI must check this file before implementation.
rules: Forms must always have grouped actions.
Dialogs must have cancel and confirm buttons.
All interactive elements must have transition-all duration-200.
Never create a component visually different from existing ones.
